name: Vivaldi
what: Every 24 hours each profile sends a unique user ID, version, CPU architecture and screen resolution to Vivaldi for user counting. There is no setting for this ping. Crash log sharing is a separate opt-in in the privacy settings; its stored preference is not verified.

steps: The daily user ID ping has no setting. Block the traffic at the network level if this matters to you.
Settings > Privacy and Security: keep automated crash log sharing turned off.
